name: Masked placeholder static auth access token
description: The HubSpot authentication overview shows an example request whose Bearer value is a row of asterisks in seven hyphen-separated groups (3, 3, 9, 4, 4, 4 and 12 asterisks). HubSpot calls it a placeholder static auth access token, so it is a documentation placeholder, not a credential. The page does not say the grouping mirrors a real token's layout, and the grouping differs from the 8-4-4-4-12 grouping in a third-party lead for private app tokens, so neither is established.

sources.supports: An example request is provided below using a placeholder static auth access token.
